pll1d37c2-d1e3501.summary: States that God also dwells in the saints by grace: he dwells only where he is, but not everywhere he is.
claims: God is where he dwells, but does not dwell everywhere he is.
God dwells only in the good.

pll1d37c2-d1e3504.summary: Isaiah 66:1 read morally: heaven (the elect) is his seat; the wicked (earth) are trodden by judgment.
claims: The elect are God's seat; the wicked are subject to his judgment.

pll1d37c2-d1e3519.summary: Wisdom: the soul of the just is the throne of wisdom, because God is more specially in the just though wholly in all.
claims: God is more specially in the just while totally in all things.

pll1d37c2-d1e3523.summary: Augustine's soul analogy: the soul is wholly in every part of the body but acts more or less intensely; likewise God is essentially in all but fuller in those who are his temple. The good are with him in part now, perfectly in beatitude; the wicked are not with him.
claims: God is essentially and wholly in all things but acts more fully in the saints.
The wicked are where God is but not with him.

pll1d37c2-d1e3541.summary: Augustine on John 17:24: the wretched may be where God is, but the blessed are with him; the good are with God by faith now, not yet by vision.
claims: Being with God means enjoying and seeing him.
The good presently are with God by faith, not vision.

pll1d37c2-d1e3575.summary: Refers to earlier discussion of the temporal procession of the Holy Spirit for understanding of God's indwelling; the Spirit does not dwell without the Father and Son.
claims: The Holy Spirit does not indwell without the Father and the Son.

pl-l1d37c2.summary: Distinguishes God's indwelling from his general presence: God is everywhere, but dwells only in the good by grace, who are his temple. Uses Scripture, the soul-body analogy, and Augustine; refers back to the treatment of the temporal mission of the Holy Spirit.
claims: God is wherever he dwells, but does not dwell wherever he is.
God is wholly present everywhere but more fully in those he inhabits.
The wicked are where God is but not with him.
